item: tests no CI job runs: a ratchet that every package-gated test file is run by a blocking job, and the one red test it hid
refs: no PR number in the row
summary: Measured against the CI install sets: 19 duckdb-gated files (201 tests, reported as 151 skips) and 2 playwright files skip in every blocking job. New test-only ratchet reads ci.yml and pyproject and fails when a gated file has no blocking job that installs the package and runs it (KNOWN_UNCOVERED records today's gap, zero slack both ways, 27 pinned cases, 3 live mutants). Running the 19 files once found one red test on DuckDB 2.0.0 (profile JSON shape) and the join-plan assertion vacuous there (the optimizer pre-aggregates); reader now takes both shapes and skips with a control query where the engine does it itself. ci.yml change is a proposal (Export owns it); also adds the disk_usage/tempfile lesson (no defect).
